facts.name: Autumn Fern
facts.color: Copper-orange new fronds, dark green later
facts.light: Part shade to shade; moist soil
facts.notes: New fronds unfurl copper-orange and mature to glossy green, and the plant stays evergreen in mild winters.

companions.why: Walters Gardens (Zeeland, Michigan) lists varieties of these as companions: Japanese forest grass, Heuchera, Hosta and foamflower.
